title: Morning Brief — Sat 28 Nov

stories.board: Russia says it shot down 1,246 Ukrainian drones
stories.headline: Russia says it stopped a huge overnight drone attack from Ukraine
stories.what: Russia's army says it shot down 1,246 Ukrainian drones overnight, with more than 400 sent toward Moscow. A drone hit a bus in the Bryansk region and hurt nine people.
stories.why: It would be one of the biggest drone attacks of the war, and it shows Ukraine can now hit deep inside Russia.
stories.sides: No major disagreement. The numbers come only from Russia and have not been checked by anyone else; Ukraine has not commented on them.

stories.board: OpenAI sues Apple back over stolen secrets claim
stories.headline: OpenAI fights back against Apple in court
stories.what: Apple sued OpenAI earlier this year, saying ex-Apple workers took secrets to help OpenAI build devices. On Friday OpenAI sued back, saying Apple pressured suppliers (companies that make parts) not to work with OpenAI.
stories.why: OpenAI, the maker of ChatGPT, is starting to build gadgets, so it is turning into a direct rival to Apple.
stories.sides: Not a left-right story: OpenAI calls Apple's lawsuit a trap to slow rivals, and Apple calls the countersuit a way to distract from the real case.

stories.board: Report finds antisemitism unchecked on Canadian campuses
stories.headline: Government report says many Canadian students shrug off antisemitism
stories.what: A report paid for by the federal government surveyed non-Jewish university students. More than half said protesting outside synagogues or boycotting (refusing to buy from) Jewish-owned shops is not antisemitism (hatred of Jews). It makes 12 suggestions, like more protection for Jewish students.
stories.why: Jewish students in Canada say they feel unsafe on campus, and this report backs up their worries with numbers.
stories.sides: No major disagreement among leaders: Culture Minister Marc Miller called the attitudes wrong, and B'nai Brith called the findings deeply disturbing.

stories.board: NBC pulls anti-Israel ad after Jewish groups object
stories.headline: NBC stops showing an anti-Israel ad that aired during SNL
stories.what: A pro-Palestinian group paid for a 30-second ad shown during a Thanksgiving Saturday Night Live broadcast. Jewish groups called it antisemitic, and NBC said it will stop airing it and review how it approves ads.
stories.why: It shows the fight over Israel and Gaza is still spilling into big American TV networks.
stories.sides: Jewish groups called the ad hateful and want an on-air apology; the ad itself argues the US should stop sending money to Israel.

quick_hits: US stocks had their best week since April 2025, with the S&P 500 up 5.6 percent, led by chip and AI companies (AP).
US regulators closed United Fidelity Bank in Indiana, the biggest US bank failure since 2024; First Citizens took over its deposits, so customers keep their money.
Tens of thousands marched in France, Italy, Portugal and Germany over high living costs and housing prices.
big_picture: Fights everywhere this morning: drones over Moscow, AI giants in court, and hard questions about antisemitism in Canada and the US.
